pr.title: feat(cli): add comment command to post on a branch's review
pr.body:
<!-- git-stk:description -->
Adds `git stk comment <message>` to post a comment on the current branch's review (`--branch` for another, `--dry-run` to preview), via `gh`, `glab`, or `tea`. For example, `git stk comment "@claude review"` asks a review bot for another pass.
<!-- /git-stk:description -->

prior_bot.note: control; bot left 5 inline and 7 summary comments during review
